$comment: Written by scripts/verify_servers.py. 'launched' means the server started and listed its tools — a liveness check only. 'ok' additionally means every declared probe ran and returned what it should, which is what tests behaviour. Probes must be safe against a target that does not exist. Do not hand-edit the observed fields.

servers.note: Built for mcphub. Addresses rules by real .id, so writes cannot hit the wrong one.
